recommendation_summary: Right now: sort the existing shared counter list by pickup date, soonest first, and have staff prepare from the top until today's cakes are done. It also says to cancel the Odoo implementation partner. No optional additions are offered, and the owner's need is fully met.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup. You also asked for an Odoo sales, inventory, and manufacturing sync because other shops are moving and you booked a partner for next week.
labels.Deleted: The Odoo rollout and the partner. Sales and inventory already reconcile, the counter already has the shared list, and those modules do not decide which cake is made first.
labels.Bottleneck: Cakes due today stayed unmade while later orders for next month were prepared. The wait is the order of work on the list everyone already reads.
labels.Checked myself: You told me the shared list has customer, pickup date, and preparation status, payments and stock reconcile, preparers can read it at the counter, and this morning today's cakes were still unmade while later next-month orders were prepared.

note: The fix is a bounded date sort of the existing list, Odoo is rejected by name, and every check is based on facts the user supplied.
